Careers

Careers at Edge226

Build the Future of Performance Advertising

We help mobile apps and games acquire and engage users through in-app, CTV, and rewarded advertising. Our platform is designed to deliver measurable outcomes that support advertisers across a wide range of industries and markets.

Our team brings together expertise across adtech, product, engineering, and performance marketing to build technology that drives real results.

We’re looking for talented, driven individuals who want to contribute to a growing platform and help shape the future of performance advertising.

View Open Roles

Why Join Edge226

Edge226 is redefining how performance advertising works. 

Fast Execution and Visible Impact

Edge226 operates in a fast execution environment where ideas move from concept to production rapidly. Team members contribute directly to features, workflows, and platform improvements used by advertisers worldwide.

Direct Access and Low Bureaucracy

Our structure enables close collaboration across teams and direct access to decision-makers. Communication is straightforward, and initiative and ownership are encouraged at every level.

A Global, Cross-Functional Team

Engineering, product, commercial, and marketing teams collaborate daily across New York, Israel , and Ukraine. Building and scaling the platform requires coordination across disciplines and time zones. Shared accountability drives progress.

Grow With the Company

As Edge226 expands, roles evolve alongside the platform. Team members often take on broader responsibilities and contribute to new initiatives across teams. Growth here comes from ownership, increased scope, and exposure to different parts of the business as we scale.
